notes.notes:
[b]BlackberryNOVA[/b]: A yuri visual novel about a girl whom graduated from high school and is now preparing herself as she enters college.

Thanks to everyone who waited! It's been a hard road. A lot has happened in these 3 years, but now, finally, it's done!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: BlueberryNOVA released on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32357215/0863835a5906a5e0fdb2c935156a03515b4a9d76.jpg[/img]

[b]BlueberryNOVA[/b] will tell you story of a girl who moved to another city and entered a new college. Meet two charming girls: Yuki and Eva. Each of them is unique in its own way and reacts differently to your actions. Will you become the best friends, stay alone or get something more? It's up to you to decide.

If you notice an error in the text / translation, please tell us novab12official@gmail.com
For more news and announcements check my twiiter: [url=https://twitter.com/novab12official]@novab12official[/url]

Have fun!
